    63→
    64→function asString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
    65→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
    66→}
    67→
    68→function asStringOrNull(value: unknown): string | null | undefined {
    69→  if (value === null) return null;
    70→  return asString(value);
    71→}
    72→
    73→function asMotionMode(value: unknown): SegmentOverrides['motionMode'] | undefined {
    74→  if (value === 'basic' || value === 'advanced') {
    75→    return value;
    76→  }
    77→
    78→  // Legacy payloads can still contain `presets`; map to `advanced`.
    79→  return value === 'presets' ? 'advanced' : undefined;
    80→}
    81→
    82→function asStructureTreatment(value: unknown): 'adjust' | 'clip' | undefined {
    83→  return value === 'adjust' || value === 'clip'
    84→    ? value
    85→    : undefined;
    86→}
    87→
    88→function isPhaseLora(value: unknown): value is PhaseConfig['phases'][number]['loras'][number] {
    89→  return isMetadataRecord(value)
    90→    && typeof value.url === 'string'
    91→    && typeof value.multiplier === 'string';
    92→}
    93→
    94→function isPhaseSetting(value: unknown): value is PhaseConfig['phases'][number] {
    95→  return isMetadataRecord(value)
    96→    && typeof value.phase === 'number'
    97→    && typeof value.guidance_scale === 'number'
    98→    && Array.isArray(value.loras)
    99→    && value.loras.every(isPhaseLora);
   100→}
   101→
   102→function isPhaseConfig(value: unknown): value is PhaseConfig {
   103→  return isMetadataRecord(value)
   104→    && typeof value.num_phases === 'number'
   105→    && Array.isArray(value.steps_per_phase)
   106→    && value.steps_per_phase.every((step) => typeof step === 'number')
   107→    && typeof value.flow_shift === 'number'
   108→    && typeof value.sample_solver === 'string'
   109→    && typeof value.model_switch_phase === 'number'
   110→    && Array.isArray(value.phases)
   111→    && value.phases.every(isPhaseSetting)
   112→    && (value.mode === undefined || value.mode === 'i2v' || value.mode === 'vace');
   113→}
   114→
   115→function parseSegmentOverrides(value: unknown): SegmentOverrides | undefined {
   116→  if (!isMetadataRecord(value)) {
   117→    return undefined;
   118→  }
   119→
   120→  const overrides: SegmentOverrides = {};
   121→  const prompt = asString(value.prompt);
   122→  if (prompt !== undefined) {
   123→    overrides.prompt = prompt;
   124→  }
   125→
   126→  const negativePrompt = asString(value.negativePrompt);
   127→  if (negativePrompt !== undefined) {
   128→    overrides.negativePrompt = negativePrompt;
   129→  }
   130→
   131→  const textBeforePrompts = asString(value.textBeforePrompts);
   132→  if (textBeforePrompts !== undefined) {
   133→    overrides.textBeforePrompts = textBeforePrompts;
   134→  }
   135→
   136→  const textAfterPrompts = asString(value.textAfterPrompts);
   137→  if (textAfterPrompts !== undefined) {
   138→    overrides.textAfterPrompts = textAfterPrompts;
   139→  }
   140→
   141→  const motionMode = asMotionMode(value.motionMode);
   142→  if (motionMode !== undefined) {
   143→    overrides.motionMode = motionMode;
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  const amountOfMotion = asNumber(value.amountOfMotion);
   147→  if (amountOfMotion !== undefined) {
   148→    overrides.amountOfMotion = amountOfMotion;
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  if (isPhaseConfig(value.phaseConfig)) {
   152→    overrides.phaseConfig = value.phaseConfig;
   153→  }
   154→
   155→  const selectedPhasePresetId = asStringOrNull(value.selectedPhasePresetId);
   156→  if (selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) {
   157→    overrides.selectedPhasePresetId = selectedPhasePresetId;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  if (Array.isArray(value.loras)) {
   161→    overrides.loras = value.loras.filter(
   162→      (item): item is NonNullable<SegmentOverrides['loras']>[number] =>
   163→        isMetadataRecord(item)
   164→        && typeof item.id === 'string'
   165→        && typeof item.name === 'string'
   166→        && typeof item.path === 'string'
   167→        && typeof item.strength === 'number',
   168→    );
   169→  }
   170→
   171→  const numFrames = asNumber(value.numFrames);
   172→  if (numFrames !== undefined) {
   173→    overrides.numFrames = numFrames;
   174→  }
   175→
   176→  const randomSeed = asBoolean(value.randomSeed);
   177→  if (randomSeed !== undefined) {
   178→    overrides.randomSeed = randomSeed;
   179→  }
   180→
   181→  const seed = asNumber(value.seed);
   182→  if (seed !== undefined) {
   183→    overrides.seed = seed;
   184→  }
   185→
   186→  const structureMotionStrength = asNumber(value.structureMotionStrength);
   187→  if (structureMotionStrength !== undefined) {
   188→    overrides.structureMotionStrength = structureMotionStrength;
   189→  }
   190→
   191→  const structureTreatment = asStructureTreatment(value.structureTreatment);
   192→  if (structureTreatment !== undefined) {
   193→    overrides.structureTreatment = structureTreatment;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  const structureUni3cEndPercent = asNumber(value.structureUni3cEndPercent);
   197→  if (structureUni3cEndPercent !== undefined) {
   198→    overrides.structureUni3cEndPercent = structureUni3cEndPercent;
   199→  }
   200→
   201→  return Object.keys(overrides).length > 0 ? overrides : undefined;
   202→}
   203→
   204→function copyUnknownExtras(
   205→  source: Record<string, unknown>,
   206→  target: GenerationMetadata,
   207→  knownKeys: Set<string>,
   208→): void {
   209→  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(source)) {
   210→    if (!knownKeys.has(key)) {
   211→      target[key] = value;
   212→    }
   213→  }
   214→}
   215→
   216→function toGenerationMetadata(value: unknown): GenerationMetadata | null {
   217→  if (!isMetadataRecord(value)) {
   218→    return null;
   219→  }
   220→
   221→  const metadata: GenerationMetadata = {};
   222→  metadata.frame_spacing = asNumber(value.frame_spacing);
   223→  metadata.end_frame = asNumber(value.end_frame);
   224→  metadata.is_keyframe = asBoolean(value.is_keyframe);
   225→  metadata.locked = asBoolean(value.locked);
   226→  metadata.context_frames = asNumber(value.context_frames);
   227→  metadata.user_positioned = asBoolean(value.user_positioned);
   228→
   229→  const createdByMode = asString(value.created_by_mode);
   230→  if (createdByMode === 'timeline' || createdByMode === 'batch') {
   231→    metadata.created_by_mode = createdByMode;
   232→  }
   233→
   234→  metadata.auto_initialized = asBoolean(value.auto_initialized);
   235→  metadata.drag_source = asString(value.drag_source);
   236→  metadata.drag_session_id = asString(value.drag_session_id);
   237→
   238→  const segmentOverrides = value.segmentOverrides;
   239→  const parsedSegmentOverrides = parseSegmentOverrides(segmentOverrides);
   240→  if (parsedSegmentOverrides) {
   241→    metadata.segmentOverrides = parsedSegmentOverrides;
   242→  }
   243→
   244→  metadata.enhanced_prompt = asString(value.enhanced_prompt);
   245→
   246→  const knownKeys = new Set([
   247→    'frame_spacing',
   248→    'end_frame',
   249→    'is_keyframe',
   250→    'locked',
   251→    'context_frames',
   252→    'user_positioned',
   253→    'created_by_mode',
   254→    'auto_initialized',
   255→    'drag_source',
   256→    'drag_session_id',
   257→    'segmentOverrides',
   258→    'enhanced_prompt',
   259→  ]);
   260→  copyUnknownExtras(value, metadata, knownKeys);
   261→
   262→  return metadata;
   263→}

     3→import { useLiveRelativeTimestamp } from './useLiveRelativeTimestamp';
     4→
     5→type RelativeTimestampPreset = 'default' | 'task' | 'processing' | 'completed';
     6→
     7→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useUpdatingTimestamp(options: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp(options);
    44→}

    47→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    48→    date,
    49→    preset: 'task',
    50→  });

    20→// Helper to derive input images from task params
    21→function deriveInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    22→  const images: string[] = [];
    23→
    24→  // Check various param locations for input images
    25→  const orchestratorDetails = params.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    26→
    27→  // Direct input_images array
    28→  if (Array.isArray(params.input_images)) {
    29→    images.push(...params.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  // Orchestrator details input_images
    33→  if (orchestratorDetails && Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails.input_images)) {
    34→    images.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  // Start/end image URLs
    38→  if (typeof params.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.start_image_url);
    39→  if (typeof params.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.end_image_url);
    40→
    41→  // Orchestrator start/end
    42→  if (orchestratorDetails) {
    43→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.start_image_url);
    44→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.end_image_url);
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  return [...new Set(images)]; // Dedupe
    48→}
    49→

    69→export function useAdjustedTaskDetails({

   165→        isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask,
   166→        error: null,
   167→        inputImages: variantInputImages,
   168→        taskId: sourceTaskId ?? activeVariant.id,
   169→        // ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so Apply button shows for all variants
   170→        onApplySettingsFromTask: taskDetailsData?.onApplySettingsFromTask,
   171→      };
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    // If variants are still loading AND we don't have task data yet, show loading
   175→    // But if we already have task data cached, show it immediately rather than blocking on variants
   176→    // This provides better UX when task data is prefetched/cached
   177→    // ALSO check if we're waiting for initialVariantId to be applied (clicked a specific variant)
   178→    const waitingForInitialVariant = initialVariantId &&
   179→      (!activeVariant || activeVariant.id !== initialVariantId);
   180→
   181→    // Only override to loading if:
   182→    // 1. Waiting for a specific variant (user clicked a variant)
   183→    // 2. Variants loading AND no active variant AND task details still loading
   184→    //    (If task details finished - either has task or knows there's none - don't block on variants)
   185→    const shouldShowLoading = waitingForInitialVariant ||
   186→      (isLoadingVariants && !activeVariant && taskDetailsData?.isLoading);
   187→
   188→    if (shouldShowLoading) {
   189→      return taskDetailsData ? { ...taskDetailsData, isLoading: true } : taskDetailsData;
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    // For all other cases, use the generation's task details as-is
   193→    return taskDetailsData;
   194→  }, [taskDetailsData, activeVariant, variantSourceTask, isLoadingVariantTask, isLoadingVariants, initialVariantId]);
   195→
   196→  return {
   197→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   198→    isLoadingVariantTask,
   199→  };
   200→}
   201→

    37→interface AbortSignalCapable<T> {
    38→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;

    40→
    41→function isAbortSignal(value: unknown): value is AbortSignal {
    42→  return !!value
    43→    && typeof value === 'object'
    44→    && 'aborted' in value
    45→    && typeof (value as AbortSignal).addEventListener === 'function';
    46→}
    47→
    48→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
    49→  if (!signal) return query;
    50→
    51→  const candidate = query as T & AbortSignalCapable<T>;
    52→  if (typeof candidate.abortSignal === 'function') {
    53→    return candidate.abortSignal(signal);
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  return query;
    57→}
    58→
    59→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {

    61→    throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {

    63→      cause: signal.reason,
    64→    });
    65→  }

    74→async function fetchSettingsForScope(
    75→  scope: SettingsScope,
    76→  id: string,
    77→  signal?: AbortSignal,
    78→) {
    79→  throwIfAborted(signal);
    80→
    81→  return maybeAttachAbortSignal(selectSettingsForScope(scope, id), signal);

    83→
    84→async function rawUpdateToolSettings(write: QueuedWrite): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
    85→  const { scope, entityId: id, toolId, patch, signal } = write;
    86→
    87→  try {
    88→    if (scope !== 'user' && scope !== 'project' && scope !== 'shot') {

    90→        'invalid_scope_identifier',
    91→        `Invalid scope: ${scope}`,
    92→      );
    93→    }
    94→

    96→
    97→    // For patch updates, we need to fetch current settings to merge
    98→    // This is necessary because the caller provides a partial update

   100→    const { data: currentEntity, error: fetchError } = await fetchSettingsForScope(scope, id, signal);

   104→      if (errorMessage.includes('ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES') ||

   121→    const currentSettings = (currentEntity?.settings as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   122→    const currentToolSettings = (currentSettings[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   123→    const updatedToolSettings = deepMerge({}, currentToolSettings, patch);
   124→
   125→    // Use atomic PostgreSQL function to update settings
   126→    // This is much faster than update() because it happens in a single DB operation
   127→    throwIfAborted(signal);
   128→    const { error: rpcError } = await maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   129→      callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
   130→        tableName,
   131→        id,

   133→        updatedToolSettings,
   134→      ),
   135→      signal,

   137→

   142→        { recoverable: true, cause: rpcError },
   143→      );
   144→    }

   146→    // CRITICAL: Return the full merged settings, not just the patch

   159→
   160→    console.error('[rawUpdateToolSettings] Error:', error);
   161→    throw error;
   162→  }
   163→}
   164→
   165→// Initialize the queue with our raw write function
   166→setSettingsWriteFunction(rawUpdateToolSettings);
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Update tool settings using the global write queue.
   170→ *
   171→ * This is the main entry point for settings updates. It:
   172→ * - Debounces rapid updates (300ms window)
   173→ * - Coalesces multiple writes to the same target
   174→ * - Serializes writes globally to prevent network exhaustion
   175→ *
   176→ * @param params - The update parameters
   177→ * @param signal - Optional AbortSignal (legacy second-arg position) for cancellation
   178→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) or 'immediate' for flush-on-unmount
   179→ * @returns The full merged settings after update
   180→ */
   181→function isSettingsWriteMode(value: unknown): value is SettingsWriteMode {
   182→  return value === 'debounced' || value === 'immediate';
   183→}
   184→
   185→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   186→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   187→  mode?: SettingsWriteMode,
   188→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   189→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   190→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   191→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   192→  mode?: SettingsWriteMode,
   193→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   194→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   195→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   196→  signalOrMode?: AbortSignal | SettingsWriteMode,
   197→  maybeMode: SettingsWriteMode = 'debounced',
   198→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
   199→  const { scope, id, toolId, patch } = params;
   200→  const signal = isAbortSignal(signalOrMode) ? signalOrMode : undefined;
   201→  const mode = isSettingsWriteMode(signalOrMode) ? signalOrMode : maybeMode;
   202→
   203→  return enqueueSettingsWrite({
   204→    scope,
   205→    entityId: id,
   206→    toolId,
   207→    patch: patch as Record<string, unknown>,
   208→    ...(signal ? { signal } : {}),
   209→  }, mode) as Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   210→}
   211→
   212→// ============================================================================
   213→// Cache format helpers
   214→// ============================================================================
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Helper to check if a cache value has the wrapper format.
   218→ * fetchToolSettingsSupabase always returns { settings, hasShotSettings },
   219→ * but legacy or manually-set cache entries may use flat format.
   220→ */
   221→function isSettingsWrapper(data: unknown): data is SettingsFetchResult {
   222→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return false;
   223→  return 'settings' in data && 'hasShotSettings' in data;
   224→}
   225→
   226→/**
   227→ * Helper to extract settings from cache data (handles wrapper format)
   228→ * Cache stores data as { settings: T, hasShotSettings: boolean }
   229→ */
   230→export function extractSettingsFromCache<T>(cacheData: unknown): T | undefined {
   231→  if (!cacheData) return undefined;
   232→  return isSettingsWrapper(cacheData) ? (cacheData.settings as T) : (cacheData as T);
   233→}
   234→
   235→/**
   236→ * Helper to update settings cache with proper wrapper format
   237→ * Use this in setQueryData callbacks for optimistic updates
   238→ *
   239→ * @param prev - The previous cache value (may be wrapper or flat format)
   240→ * @param updater - Either an object of updates, or a function that receives prevSettings and returns updates
   241→ */
   242→export function updateSettingsCache<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
   243→  prev: unknown,
   244→  updater: Partial<T> | ((prevSettings: T) => Partial<T>)
   245→): SettingsFetchResult<T> {
   246→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(prev);
   247→  const prevSettings = (wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) : (prev ?? {})) as T;
   248→  const updates = typeof updater === 'function' ? updater(prevSettings) : updater;
   249→  return {
   250→    settings: { ...prevSettings, ...updates } as T,
   251→    hasShotSettings: wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→// ============================================================================
   256→// Query retry helper
   257→// ============================================================================
   258→
   259→/** Determines whether a failed settings query should be retried. */
   260→function shouldRetrySettingsQuery(failureCount: number, error: Error): boolean {
   261→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   262→  if (
   263→    classified.code === 'auth_required'
   264→    || classified.code === 'cancelled'
   265→    || classified.code === 'network'
   266→  ) {
   267→    return false;
   268→  }
   269→  return failureCount < 3;
   270→}
   271→
   272→// ============================================================================
   273→// Mutation success/error helpers
   274→// ============================================================================
   275→
   276→/** Merge mutation result into query cache and refetch related caches. */
   277→function handleMutationSuccess(
   278→  fullMergedSettings: Record<string, unknown> | null,
   279→  toolId: string,
   280→  projectId: string | undefined,
   281→  shotId: string | undefined,
   282→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   283→) {
   284→  if (fullMergedSettings === null) return;
   285→
   286→  queryClient.setQueryData(
   287→    queryKeys.settings.tool(toolId, projectId, shotId),
   288→    (oldData: unknown) => {
   289→      const oldWrapper = isSettingsWrapper(oldData);
   290→      const oldSettings = oldWrapper
   291→        ? (((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)
   292→        : ((oldData ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>);
   293→      const mergedSettings = deepMerge({}, oldSettings, fullMergedSettings);
   294→
   295→      return {
   296→        settings: mergedSettings,
   297→        hasShotSettings: oldWrapper ? ((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   298→      };
   299→    }
   300→  );
   301→
   302→  if (shotId) {
   303→    queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   304→  }
   305→}
   306→
   307→/** Log/toast mutation errors and invalidate cache for non-network failures. */
   308→function handleMutationError(
   309→  error: Error,
   310→  toolId: string,
   311→  projectId: string | undefined,
   312→  shotId: string | undefined,
   313→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   314→) {
   315→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   316→
   317→  if (classified.code === 'cancelled') {
   318→    return;
   319→  }
   320→
   321→  if (classified.code === 'network') return;
   322→
   323→  normalizeAndPresentError(classified, { context: 'useToolSettings.update', toastTitle: `Failed to save ${toolId} settings` });
   324→
   325→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   326→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId)
   327→  });
   328→}
   329→
   330→// Type overloads
   331→export function useToolSettings<T>(toolId: string, context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }): {
   332→  settings: T | undefined;
   333→  isLoading: boolean;
   334→  error: Error | null;
   335→  update: (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>) => Promise<void>;
   336→  isUpdating: boolean;
   337→  /** Whether the shot had settings stored in DB (vs just defaults/project settings) */
   338→  hasShotSettings: boolean;
   339→};
   340→
   341→/**
   342→ * Low-level hook for reading and writing tool settings across all scopes.
   343→ *
   344→ * Performs cascade resolution (defaults -> user -> project -> shot) and returns
   345→ * a merged settings object. Writes go through the global settings write queue.
   346→ *
   347→ * Most features should use `useAutoSaveSettings` instead, which adds auto-save,
   348→ * dirty tracking, and entity-change handling on top of this hook.
   349→ *
   350→ * Use this directly only when you need manual save control or complex write patterns.
   351→ *
   352→ * @see docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md for the full settings hook decision tree
   353→ */
   354→export function useToolSettings<T>(
   355→  toolId: string,
   356→  context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }
   357→) {
   358→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   359→
   360→  // Determine parameter shapes
   361→  const projectIdFromRuntime = getProjectSelectionFallbackId() ?? undefined;
   362→  const projectId: string | undefined = context?.projectId ?? projectIdFromRuntime ?? undefined;
   363→  const shotId: string | undefined = context?.shotId;
   364→  const fetchEnabled: boolean = context?.enabled ?? true;
   365→
   366→  // Refs to access current values in stable callbacks without recreating them
   367→  const projectIdRef = useRef(projectId);
   368→  projectIdRef.current = projectId;
   369→  const shotIdRef = useRef(shotId);
   370→  shotIdRef.current = shotId;
   371→
   372→  // Fetch merged settings using Supabase with mobile optimizations
   373→  const { data: queryResult, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
   374→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId),
   375→    queryFn: async ({ signal }): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   376→      return fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(toolId, { projectId, shotId }, signal);
   377→    },
   378→    enabled: !!toolId && fetchEnabled,
   379→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.static,
   380→    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
   381→    retry: shouldRetrySettingsQuery,
   382→    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
   383→    networkMode: 'online',
   384→  });
   385→
   386→  // Extract settings and hasShotSettings from the query result
   387→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(queryResult);
   388→  const settings = wrapper ? (queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).settings : queryResult;
   389→  const hasShotSettings = wrapper ? ((queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false;
   390→
   391→  // Log errors for debugging (except expected cancellations)
   392→  if (error && classifyToolSettingsError(error).code !== 'cancelled') {
   393→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToolSettings', showToast: false });
   394→  }
   395→
   396→  // Update settings mutation
   397→  const updateMutation = useMutation({
   398→    mutationFn: async ({ scope, settings: newSettings, entityId }: {
   399→      scope: SettingsScope;
   400→      settings: Partial<T>;
   401→      entityId?: string;
   402→    }) => {
   403→      let idForScope: string | undefined = entityId;
   404→
   405→      if (!idForScope) {
   406→        if (scope === 'user') {
   407→          const { data: { user } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   408→          idForScope = user?.id;
   409→          if (!idForScope) {
   410→            throw new ToolSettingsError(
   411→              'auth_required',
   412→              'Authentication required for user settings update',
   413→            );
   414→          }
   415→        } else if (scope === 'project') {
   416→          idForScope = projectId;
   417→        } else if (scope === 'shot') {
   418→          idForScope = shotId;
   419→        }
   420→      }
   421→
   422→      if (!idForScope) {
   423→        throw new ToolSettingsError(
   424→          'invalid_scope_identifier',
   425→          `Missing identifier for ${scope} tool settings update`,
   426→        );
   427→      }
   428→
   429→      const fullMergedSettings = await updateToolSettingsSupabase({
   430→          scope,
   431→          id: idForScope,
   432→          toolId,
   433→          patch: newSettings,
   434→      });
   435→
   436→      return fullMergedSettings;
   437→    },
   438→    onSuccess: (fullMergedSettings) => {
   439→      handleMutationSuccess(fullMergedSettings, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   440→    },
   441→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   442→      handleMutationError(error, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   443→    },
   444→  });
   445→
   446→  // Get stable reference to mutateAsync - useMutation returns a new object each render
   447→  // but mutateAsync itself is stable
   448→  const mutateAsyncRef = useRef(updateMutation.mutateAsync);
   449→  mutateAsyncRef.current = updateMutation.mutateAsync;
   450→
   451→  // CRITICAL: Wrap in useCallback with stable deps to prevent cascading re-renders.
   452→  // Use refs to access current projectId/shotId without recreating this function.
   453→  // The entityId is snapshotted at call time via refs for correctness.
   454→  const update = useCallback(async (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>): Promise<void> => {
   455→    // Snapshot the target entity id NOW to prevent cross-project/shot overwrites
   456→    // Use refs to get current values without causing callback recreation
   457→    const entityId = scope === 'project' ? projectIdRef.current : (scope === 'shot' ? shotIdRef.current : undefined);
   458→
   459→    // NOTE: No debounce here - callers (like useShotSettings) are responsible for debouncing.
   460→    // Using mutateAsync so callers can await the actual DB write completion.
   461→    // Use ref to access stable mutateAsync without recreating this callback.
   462→    await mutateAsyncRef.current({ scope, settings, entityId });
   463→  }, []); // Empty deps - all values accessed via refs for stability
   464→
   465→  return useMemo(() => ({
   466→    settings: settings as T | undefined,
   467→    isLoading,
   468→    error: error as Error | null,
   469→    update,
   470→    isUpdating: updateMutation.isPending,
   471→    hasShotSettings,
   472→  }), [settings, isLoading, error, update, updateMutation.isPending, hasShotSettings]);
   473→}
   474→

1→/**
     2→ * Runtime project selection snapshot for non-React consumers.
     3→ *
     4→ * This replaces ad-hoc window globals with an explicit typed access layer.
     5→ */
     6→const [REDACTED];
     7→
     8→interface ProjectSelectionSnapshot {
     9→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    10→}
    11→
    12→type ProjectSelectionListener = (snapshot: ProjectSelectionSnapshot) => void;
    13→
    14→function readPersistedProjectSelection(): string | null {
    15→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    16→    return null;
    17→  }
    18→
    19→  try {
    20→    const persisted = window.localStorage.getItem(PROJECT_SELECTION_STORAGE_KEY);
    21→    return persisted && persisted.trim().length > 0 ? persisted : null;
    22→  } catch {
    23→    return null;
    24→  }
    25→}
    26→
    27→let snapshot: ProjectSelectionSnapshot = {
    28→  selectedProjectId: readPersistedProjectSelection(),
    29→};
    30→
    31→const listeners = new Set<ProjectSelectionListener>();
    32→
    33→export function setProjectSelectionSnapshot(next: ProjectSelectionSnapshot): void {
    34→  const normalized: ProjectSelectionSnapshot = {
    35→    selectedProjectId: next.selectedProjectId ?? null,
    36→  };
    37→  if (snapshot.selectedProjectId === normalized.selectedProjectId) {
    38→    return;
    39→  }
    40→  snapshot = normalized;
    41→  for (const listener of listeners) {
    42→    listener(snapshot);
    43→  }
    44→}
    45→
    46→export function getProjectSelectionSnapshot(): ProjectSelectionSnapshot {
    47→  return snapshot;
    48→}
    49→
    50→export function getProjectSelectionFallbackId(): string | null {
    51→  return snapshot.selectedProjectId ?? readPersistedProjectSelection();
    52→}
    53→

    93→function resolveSiblingLimits(params: StripTapPlacementParams) {

   138→  return { start: params.effectiveOutputStart, end: newEnd };

   199→/**

   201→ *

   204→ * - Double-tap detection (to toggle strip active state)
   205→ * - Single-tap frame preview (delegates to parent via callback)

   208→export function useTabletEndpointSelection(
   209→  options: UseTabletEndpointSelectionOptions,
   210→): UseTabletEndpointSelectionReturn {
   211→  const {
   212→    enabled,
   213→    isStripActive,
   214→    isTablet,
   215→    stripLeftPercent,
   216→    stripWidthPercent,
   217→    fullMin,

   225→    onDoubleTap,
   226→    onSingleTap,
   227→  } = options;
   228→
   229→  const [selectedEndpoint, setSelectedEndpoint] = useState<'left' | 'right' | null>(null);
   230→  const touchStartPosRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
   231→  const lastTapTimeRef = useRef<number>(0);
   232→
   233→  // Tap-to-place hint visibility
   234→  const tapToPlaceHint = useTemporaryVisibility(2000);
   235→
   236→  // Show/hide tap-to-place hint when endpoint selection changes
   237→  useEffect(() => {
   238→    if (selectedEndpoint && enabled) {
   239→      tapToPlaceHint.show();
   240→    } else {
   241→      tapToPlaceHint.hide();
   242→    }
   243→  }, [selectedEndpoint, enabled, tapToPlaceHint]);
   244→
   245→  // iPad: touch outside to deselect endpoint
   246→  useClickOutside(
   247→    () => setSelectedEndpoint(null),
   248→    { events: ['touchstart'], enabled: !!selectedEndpoint && !!enabled, delay: 100 },
   249→    outerContainerRef as React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>
   250→  );
   251→
   252→  /** Clear endpoint selection (for use by parent click-outside handlers) */
   253→  const clearSelection = useCallback(() => {
   254→    setSelectedEndpoint(null);
   255→  }, []);
   256→
   257→  // Touch start handler for resize handle endpoints
   258→  const handleEndpointTouchStart = useCallback((_endpoint: 'left' | 'right', e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   259→    if (!enabled) return;
   260→    const touch = e.touches[0];
   261→    touchStartPosRef.current = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY };
   262→  }, [enabled]);
   263→
   264→  // Touch end handler for resize handle endpoints
   265→  const handleEndpointTouchEnd = useCallback((_endpoint: 'left' | 'right', e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   266→    if (!enabled || !touchStartPosRef.current) return;
   267→
   268→    const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
   269→    const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - touchStartPosRef.current.x);
   270→    const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - touchStartPosRef.current.y);
   271→    touchStartPosRef.current = null;
   272→
   273→    if (deltaX > SCROLL_THRESHOLD || deltaY > SCROLL_THRESHOLD) return;

   280→  const handleStripTapToPlace = useStripTapToPlace({

   282→    selectedEndpoint,
   283→    outerContainerRef,
   284→    onRangeChange,
   285→    stripLeftPercent,
   286→    stripWidthPercent,
   287→    fullMin,
   288→    fullMax,
   289→    fullRange,

   291→    effectiveOutputEnd,
   292→    siblingRanges,

   294→  });
   295→
   296→  // Track touch start for tap detection on strip body
   297→  const handleStripTouchStart = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   298→    if (!enabled) return;
   299→    const touch = e.touches[0];
   300→    touchStartPosRef.current = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY };
   301→  }, [enabled]);
   302→
   303→  // Touch end handler for strip body - dispatches to tap-to-place, double-tap, or single-tap
   304→  const handleStripTouchEnd = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
   305→    if (!touchStartPosRef.current) return;
   306→

   308→    const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - touchStartPosRef.current.x);
   309→    const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - touchStartPosRef.current.y);
   310→    touchStartPosRef.current = null;

   317→    // If endpoint selected and strip active, place it
   318→    if (selectedEndpoint && isStripActive && enabled) {

   321→    }
   322→
   323→    // Double-tap detection for iPad
   324→    const now = Date.now();

   336→    }
   337→  }, [enabled, selectedEndpoint, handleStripTapToPlace, isTablet, isStripActive, onDoubleTap, onSingleTap]);

   341→    clearSelection,
   342→    tapToPlaceHintVisible: tapToPlaceHint.isVisible,
   343→    handleEndpointTouchStart,
   344→    handleEndpointTouchEnd,
   345→    handleStripTouchStart,
   346→    handleStripTouchEnd,
   347→  };
   348→}

   351→export type { UseTabletEndpointSelectionReturn };

   124→            projectAspectRatio={form.projectAspectRatio}
   125→            disabled={form.automatedSubmitButton.isSubmitting}
   126→            isLocalGeneration={form.isLocalGenerationEnabled}
   127→          />
   128→        </div>
   129→
   130→        {/* Spacer to ensure content can scroll above sticky footer (only when not using portal) */}
   131→        {stickyFooter && !footerPortalId && <div className="h-4" />}
   132→
   133→        {/* Footer: portaled when footerPortalId provided, sticky when stickyFooter without portal, inline otherwise */}
   134→        {(() => {
   135→          const footerContent = (
   136→            <div className={
   137→              stickyFooter
   138→                ? footerPortalId
   139→                  ? "px-6 py-3 bg-background border-t border-zinc-700" // Portaled footer
   140→                  : "sticky bottom-0 z-50 !mt-0 -mx-6 px-6 py-3 bg-background border-t border-zinc-700" // Sticky footer
   141→                : "border-t border-border pt-6 mt-2" // Inline footer (tool page)
   142→            }>
   143→              <GenerateControls
   144→                imagesPerPrompt={form.imagesPerPrompt}
   145→                onChangeImagesPerPrompt={form.handleSliderChange(form.setImagesPerPrompt)}
   146→                actionablePromptsCount={form.actionablePromptsCount}
   147→                isGenerating={form.automatedSubmitButton.isSubmitting}
   148→                justQueued={form.automatedSubmitButton.isSuccess}
   149→                promptMode={form.effectivePromptMode}
   150→                onUseExistingPrompts={form.handleUseExistingPrompts}
   151→                onNewPromptsLikeExisting={form.handleNewPromptsLikeExisting}
   152→                promptMultiplier={form.promptMultiplier}
   153→                onChangePromptMultiplier={form.setPromptMultiplier}
   154→              />
   155→            </div>
   156→          );
   157→
   158→          // Portal footer outside scroll container when footerPortalId is provided
   159→          if (stickyFooter && footerPortalId) {
   160→            const portalTarget = document.getElementById(footerPortalId);
   161→            return portalTarget ? createPortal(footerContent, portalTarget) : footerContent;
   162→          }
   163→          return footerContent;
   164→        })()}
   165→      </form>
   166→
   167→      <ChunkLoadErrorBoundary>
   168→        <Suspense fallback={<div className="sr-only">Loading...</div>}>
   169→          <LazyLoraSelectorModal
   170→            isOpen={form.loraManager.isLoraModalOpen}
   171→            onClose={() => form.loraManager.setIsLoraModalOpen(false)}
   172→            loras={form.availableLoras}

   183→        <Suspense fallback={<div className="sr-only">Loading...</div>}>

   187→            prompts={form.prompts}

   191→            onGenerateAndQueue={form.handleGenerateAndQueue}

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   109→ */
   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   111→  generationIds: string[]
   112→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   113→  try {
   114→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   117→    return {
   118→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   119→      degraded: true,
   120→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   121→    };
   122→  }
   123→}
   124→
   125→/**
   126→ * Raw variant record from generation_variants table (before transformation)
   127→ */
   128→export interface RawVariant {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_id: string;
   131→  location: string;
   132→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   133→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   134→  variant_type?: string | null;
   135→  name?: string | null;
   136→  created_at: string;
   137→  /** Only present for derived-items queries */
   138→  is_primary?: boolean;
   139→  viewed_at?: string | null;
   140→}
   141→
   142→/**
   143→ * Raw generation record from database (before transformation)
   144→ */
   145→export interface RawGeneration {
   146→  id: string;
   147→  location: string;
   148→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   149→  type?: string | null;
   150→  created_at: string;
   151→  updated_at?: string | null;
   152→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   153→  starred?: boolean | null;
   154→  tasks?: string[] | string | null;
   155→  based_on?: string | null;
   156→  name?: string | null;
   157→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   158→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   159→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   160→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   161→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   162→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   163→  child_order?: number | null;
   164→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   165→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   166→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   167→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   172→ */
   173→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   174→  id: string;
   175→  shot_id: string;
   176→  generation_id: string;
   177→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   178→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   179→  created_at?: string;
   180→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   181→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Options for transformation customization
   186→ */
   187→interface TransformOptions {
   188→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   189→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   190→  /** Timeline frame position */
   191→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   192→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   193→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   194→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   195→  shotId?: string;
   196→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   197→  verbose?: boolean;
   198→}
   199→
   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}
   244→
   245→/**
   246→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   247→ */
   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   251→}
   252→
   253→/**
   254→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   255→ * 
   256→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   257→ * 
   258→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   259→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   260→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   261→ */
   262→export function transformGeneration(
   263→  item: RawGeneration,
   264→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   265→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   266→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   267→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   268→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   269→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   270→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   271→  
   272→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   273→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   274→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   275→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}

    10→/**
    11→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    12→ */
    13→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    14→  if (!params) return {};
    15→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    16→    try {
    17→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    18→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    19→    } catch {
    20→      return {};
    21→    }

    26→/**
    27→ * Derive input images from task params
    28→ *
    29→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    30→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    31→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    32→ *
    33→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    34→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    35→ */
    36→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    37→  const params = parsedParams;
    38→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    39→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    40→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    41→      return travelImages;
    42→    }
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    46→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    47→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    48→
    49→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    50→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    51→
    52→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)
    53→  if (isSegmentTask) {
    54→    // Priority: individual_segment_params > top-level input_image_paths_resolved
    55→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    56→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    57→    }
    58→    // Fallback to start/end image URLs
    59→    if (segmentParams?.start_image_url || segmentParams?.end_image_url) {
    60→      const urls: string[] = [];
    61→      if (typeof segmentParams?.start_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.start_image_url);
    62→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);
    63→      return urls;
    64→    }
    65→    // Fallback to top-level (which should be segment-specific for segment tasks)
    66→    if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    67→      return params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    68→    }
    69→    return [];
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  // For non-segment tasks, collect from all locations
    73→  const urls: string[] = [];
    74→
    75→  // Image edit task paths
    76→  if (typeof params?.image_url === 'string') urls.push(params.image_url);
    77→  if (typeof params?.image === 'string') urls.push(params.image);
    78→  if (typeof params?.input_image === 'string') urls.push(params.input_image);
    79→  if (typeof params?.init_image === 'string') urls.push(params.init_image);
    80→  if (typeof params?.control_image === 'string') urls.push(params.control_image);
    81→  if (Array.isArray(params?.images)) urls.push(...params.images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    82→  if (Array.isArray(params?.input_images)) urls.push(...params.input_images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    83→  if (typeof params?.mask_url === 'string') urls.push(params.mask_url);
    84→
    85→  // Travel/video task paths - orchestrator details contain all images for full timeline
    86→  if (Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    87→    urls.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    88→  } else if (Array.isArray(orchestratorPayload?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    89→    urls.push(...orchestratorPayload.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    90→  } else if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    91→    urls.push(...params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  return Array.from(new Set(urls.filter(Boolean)));
    95→}

    97→/**
    98→ * Extract prompt from task params
    99→ *
   100→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first

   102→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt
   103→ *
   104→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,
   105→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   106→ *
   107→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   108→ * @returns The prompt string or null

   110→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {

   112→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {

   116→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);

   134→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;

   143→      ) ?? null
   144→    );
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   148→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   149→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   150→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   151→  // cleared the global prompt.
   152→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   153→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   154→  return (

   162→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],

   198→/**

   206→
   207→/**
   208→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)
   209→ */
   210→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   211→  const params = parsedParams;

   216→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;

   226→          strength: parsedStrength,
   227→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),

   237→      url,
   238→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   239→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   240→    }));
   241→  }

   246→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {

   251→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   252→  'individualSegmentParams',
   253→  'taskViewContract',
   254→  'familyContract',
   255→  'rawParams',

   257→

   261→  'orchestratorDetails',
   262→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   263→  'rawParams',

   266→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [

   270→  'orchestratorDetails',
   271→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   272→  'rawParams',
   273→];
   274→
   275→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   276→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   277→}
   278→
   279→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {

   285→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   286→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined

   288→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   289→  );

   292→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   293→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   294→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   295→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   296→
   297→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   298→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   299→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   300→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   304→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   306→  }
   307→
   308→  const timelineSources = [
   309→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   310→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   311→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   312→  ];
   313→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   314→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   315→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   316→    }
   317→  }
   318→
   319→  return [];
   320→}
   321→
   322→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   323→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   324→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   325→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   326→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   327→
   328→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   329→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   330→      'orchestratorDetails',
   331→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   332→      'rawParams',
   333→    ]);
   334→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   335→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   336→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   337→    );
   338→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   339→      return enhancedPrompt;
   340→    }
   341→
   342→    return (
   343→      pickFirstString(
   344→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   345→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   346→      ) ?? null
   347→    );
   348→  }
   349→
   350→  return (
   351→    pickFirstString(
   352→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   353→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   354→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   355→    ) ?? null
   356→  );
   357→}
   358→
   359→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   360→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   361→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
   362→}
   363→
   364→function asString(value: unknown): string | null {
   365→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
   366→}
   367→
   368→function asStringArray(value: unknown): string[] | null {
   369→  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
   370→  return value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string');
   371→}
   372→
   373→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   374→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   375→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   376→  return numeric;
   377→}
   378→
   379→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   380→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   381→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   382→}
   383→
   384→function pickFirstString(...values: unknown[]): string | null {
   385→  for (const value of values) {
   386→    const text = asString(value);
   387→    if (text) return text;
   388→  }
   389→  return null;
   390→}

    23→export function useAutoTopupState({ initialPurchaseAmount }: UseAutoTopupStateProps): UseAutoTopupStateReturn {

    31→  const [localAutoTopupEnabled, setLocalAutoTopupEnabled] = useState(true);
    32→  const [localAutoTopupThreshold, setLocalAutoTopupThreshold] = useState(10);
    33→  const [hasInitialized, setHasInitialized] = useState(false);
    34→
    35→  // Debounce timer for threshold changes
    36→  const thresholdDebounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    37→
    38→  // Initialize from server preferences
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (autoTopupPreferences && !hasInitialized) {
    41→      setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(autoTopupPreferences.enabled);
    42→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(autoTopupPreferences.threshold || 10);
    43→
    44→      if (autoTopupPreferences.amount && autoTopupPreferences.amount !== 50) {
    45→        setPurchaseAmount(autoTopupPreferences.amount);
    46→      }
    47→
    48→      setHasInitialized(true);
    49→    }
    50→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, hasInitialized]);
    51→
    52→  // Auto-update threshold for new users when purchase amount changes
    53→  useEffect(() => {
    54→    if (hasInitialized && autoTopupPreferences && autoTopupPreferences.threshold === 10 && purchaseAmount !== 50) {
    55→      const defaultThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(purchaseAmount / 5));
    56→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(defaultThreshold);
    57→    }
    58→  }, [purchaseAmount, hasInitialized, autoTopupPreferences]);
    59→
    60→  // Cleanup debounce timer on unmount
    61→  useEffect(() => {
    62→    return () => {
    63→      if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
    64→        clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
    65→      }
    66→    };
    67→  }, []);
    68→

    99→    }

   101→      updateAutoTopup({

    32→
    33→export function useJoinClips({
    34→  media,
    35→  isVideo,
    36→  selectedProjectId,
    37→}: UseJoinClipsProps): UseJoinClipsReturn {
    38→  const navigate = useNavigate();

    40→  const [isAddingToJoin, setIsAddingToJoin] = useState(false);

    47→    }

    52→      // For videos, 'location' is the primary storage field

    56→      const thumbnailUrl = media.thumbUrl || media.thumbnail_url;

    65→      const [REDACTED](selectedProjectId, userId);

    67→      // Get existing pending clips or start fresh
    68→      const existingData = localStorage.getItem(queueKey);
    69→      const parsedPending = existingData ? JSON.parse(existingData) : [];
    70→      const pendingClips: PendingJoinClipEntry[] = Array.isArray(parsedPending) ? parsedPending : [];
    71→
    72→      // Add new clip (avoid duplicates by generationId)
    73→      if (!pendingClips.some(clip => clip.generationId === media.id)) {
    74→        const newClip: PendingJoinClipEntry = {
    75→          videoUrl,
    76→          thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl ?? undefined,
    77→          generationId: media.id,
    78→          timestamp: Date.now(),
    79→          ...(selectedProjectId ? { projectId: selectedProjectId } : {}),
    80→          ...(userId ? { userId } : {}),
    81→        };
    82→        enqueueJoinClipsIntent(newClip, { projectId: selectedProjectId, userId });
    83→        pendingClips.push(newClip);
    84→        localStorage.setItem(queueKey, JSON.stringify(pendingClips));
    85→      }
    86→
    87→      setAddToJoinSuccess(true);
    88→      setTimeout(() => setAddToJoinSuccess(false), 2000);
    89→    } catch (error) {
    90→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useJoinClips', showToast: false });
    91→    } finally {
    92→      setIsAddingToJoin(false);
    93→    }
    94→  }, [media, isVideo, selectedProjectId]);
    95→
    96→  const handleGoToJoin = useCallback(() => {
    97→    navigate(TOOL_ROUTES.JOIN_CLIPS);
    98→  }, [navigate]);

   100→  return {
   101→    isAddingToJoin,
